info.title: solver-query
info.description: Read-only query service over the solutions library; it never solves (ADR 0018). Errors are RFC 9457 problem details (application/problem+json).

get.summary: The request counters, the latency histogram and the library gauges as Prometheus text.
get.description:
# Errors

None today: the registry's lock is reused when poisoned, so every scrape answers.

get.summary:
What the library holds for a configuration and pair: preflop availability, flops by
texture family and the build queue.
get.description:
# Errors

`ApiError::BadRequest` (400) for a configuration identifier or a pair that does not
parse. A database that does not answer is reported in the body, not as an error.
`ApiError::Unavailable` (503) when `classes=true` and the pair's preflop solution is
marked unavailable.

parameters.name: pair
parameters.description: The position pair, out of position first.

parameters.name: classes
parameters.description:
True to list the pair's spot classes in `spot_classes` (O-270); absent or false
leaves it empty, so a plain coverage call walks no tree.

400.description: A malformed configuration identifier or pair

503.description: The solution the class walk reads is marked unavailable

post.summary:
Deals a scenario from a seed: the start node, both hands and the solutions in play.
The board stays server-side until each street is revealed (A5 rule two).
post.description:
# Errors

`ApiError::BadRequest` for a configuration, pair, street, line, spot-class key or seed
that does not parse, or a filter v1 does not take (a texture, a street other than
preflop); `ApiError::NotFound` when no solution of the pair holds the start node;
`ApiError::Unavailable` when a solution of the pair is marked unavailable.

200.description: The deal, with no board card

400.description: A malformed configuration, pair, line, seed or a filter v1 does not support (a texture, a street other than preflop)

404.description: No solution holds the start node

get.summary:
Reveals the next street of a deal: the flop first, then the turn, then the river. A
repeat answers the same cards.
get.description:
# Errors

`ApiError::BadRequest` for an id that is not a lowercase UUID or a street other than
flop, turn or river; `ApiError::NotFound` for a deal the store does not hold (post the
seed and filter again to recreate it); `ApiError::Conflict` for a street revealed out
of order.

parameters.name: street
parameters.description: The street to reveal: `flop`, `turn` or `river`, in that order.

200.description: The street's cards and the board so far

400.description: A street other than flop, turn or river

404.description: No such deal; post the seed again to recreate it

409.description: The street is revealed out of order

post.summary:
Grades one decision: expected value (EV) loss in big blinds and percent of the pot, the
floor (O-22), the bucket, the noise flags and the difficulty features.
post.description:
# Errors

`ApiError::BadRequest` for a malformed solution id, node key or hand, an action index
out of range or a reference over 64 characters; `ApiError::NotFound` for a solution,
node or hand that does not exist; `ApiError::Unavailable` for a solution the reader
marked unavailable.

400.description: A malformed solution id, node key or hand, an action index out of range, or a reference over 64 characters

404.description: No such solution, node or hand

get.summary:
The E3 insight data for one hand at one node: threshold card, equity distributions,
range and nut advantage, blockers, hand role and noise flags.
get.description:
# Errors

`ApiError::BadRequest` for a key, solution id or hand that does not parse (or a class
at a 1,326-combo node); `ApiError::NotFound` for a solution or node the library does
not hold or a hand the node does not hold; `ApiError::Unavailable` when the solution
is marked unavailable.

parameters.name: node_key
parameters.description: The node key in the A3 section 1 grammar.

parameters.name: hand
parameters.description: The hand: a class (`AKs`) or a combo (`AhKh`).

400.description: A malformed solution id, node key or hand

404.description: No such solution, node or hand

get.summary: One node of one solution with its actions, hand rows and range summaries.

parameters.name: solution_id
parameters.description:
The solution to read: a lowercase universally unique identifier (UUID) the library
registry indexed at startup (O-144).

parameters.name: node_key
parameters.description: The node key in the A3 section 1 grammar.

parameters.name: hands
parameters.description:
Which hands to list: `all` (the default), `class`, or one hand given as a class
(`AKs`) or a combo (`AhKh`, mapped to its class at a preflop node).

400.description: A malformed solution id, node key or hand filter

post.summary:
Draws the opponent's action at a node from the hand's frequencies and returns the
generator state to send next.

400.description: A malformed solution id, node key, hand or state

404.description: No such solution, node or hand

ActionKind.description: The kind of an action, the token letter spelled out.

ActionShare.description: The reach-weighted share of the acting seat's range taking one action.

index.description: The action's index in the record.

share.description: The share of the acting seat's range taking it, 0 to 1.

ActionView.description: One action of the node in record order.

bucket.description:
The bet-size bucket as `gto_model::Bucket::as_str` (`tiny`, `small`, `medium`, `pot`,
`overbet-small`, `overbet-large`, `all-in`), computed at pack time and never
recomputed here (ADR 0004, O-120); null for a fold, check, call, limp or straddle.

index.description: The action's index in the record, the one `/v1/grade` takes.

label.description:
The button label: the bucket's Grouped label postflop (`Overbet small`) and the exact
size at a preflop node, for example `Raise to 2.5bb` (O-22).

next_node_key.description:
The node this action leads to when the solution holds it; null when the action
ends the solution (a fold, or the action that closes its last street). The api walks
trees through it and never builds a child key itself (O-245, ADR 0004); additive.

size_cbb.description: The total wager in centi-big-blinds (cbb); 0 for a fold or a check.

token.description: The action token text, for example `r250`.

BlockedClass.description: One villain class the hand blocks.

reach_removed.description: The villain reach the hand's cards remove from that class.

Blockers.description: What the hand's cards remove from the villain's range.

top_blocked.description: The five most blocked villain classes, most blocked first.

villain_combos_removed.description: How many villain combos the hand's cards remove.

villain_reach_removed_share.description:
The removed reach as a share of the villain's reach-weighted combos (the mean over
the combos of a class when the hand was given as a class).

ClassHistoryEntry.description:
One action on the way from the pair's root to a class spot, labelled as `/v1/nodes`
labels its buttons.

label.description: The button label of the action.

position.description: The seat that took the action.

ClassSpot.description: One decision node of a spot class: where a hand of the class is dealt.

hero_position.description: The seat to act at the node, the hero of a hand dealt there.

history.description: The actions of the line, in order.

line.description: The dotted preflop line from the pair's root; null for the root itself.

line_reach.description:
The probability that play reaches the node from the root: the product, over the
line, of the acting seat's reach-weighted share of each action taken (O-270).

pot_cbb.description: The pot at the node in centi-big-blinds (cbb).

start_node_key.description: The node key of the decision.

flops.description: Flops held, from the database; empty without one.

queue.description: Queued build jobs, from the database; empty without one.

spot_classes.description:
The spot classes of the pair's first indexed preflop solution, by key (O-270).
Always present; empty unless `classes=true`, and empty when the pair holds no
preflop solution or the configuration is outside the v1 catalog.

textures.description: Texture families held, from the database; empty without one.

CoverageSource.description: Where a preflop solution was found.

configured.description: True when `QUERY_DB_PASSWORD` is set (the query-role connection is configured).

connected.description: True when the role probe answered on this request.

role.description: The role the probe reported, `query` when connected as expected; null otherwise.

DealFilter.description: What to deal (O-145 narrows A5's filters in v1).

line.description:
The dotted preflop action line to start at, for example `r250`; the pair's root
(the empty line) when absent.

pair.description: The position pair, out of position first.

spot_class_key.description: A spot-class key to start at, resolved through a per-family candidate line table.

start_street.description: The street the deal starts on: `preflop` only in v1.

texture.description: A texture family; rejected with 400 in v1 (preflop only).

DealResponse.description: The body of a `POST /v1/deal` answer. No board card is here (A5 rule two).

deal_id.description: The deal id, derived from the seed and the filter, as a UUID string (O-152).

hero_position.description: The seat to act at the start node, as `gto_model::Position::as_str`.

revealed.description: What has been revealed, nothing at this point.

solution_ids.description: The solutions the registry holds for the configuration and pair.

start_node_key.description: The node key the deal starts at.

DifficultyFeatures.description: How hard the decision was, for the trainer's scheduling (R4.4).

all_within_floor.description: True when every nonzero loss is under the floor, so no action can be graded wrong.

ev_gap_pct_pot.description: The best action's EV minus the second best, in percent of the pot; 0 with one action.

mixed.description: True when two or more actions are played at 5 percent or more.

n_actions.description: How many actions the node offers.

purity.description: The largest frequency of any action.

EquityDistribution.description: Each seat's range equity as a histogram of ten bins from 0 to 1.

ip.description: The in-position range's reach-weighted share per bin, summing to 1.

oop.description: The out-of-position range's reach-weighted share per bin, summing to 1.

FixtureLibrary.description: What the service knows about the fixture library directory.

path.description: `FIXTURE_LIBRARY_PATH` as configured, or null when unset.

present.description: Whether that directory exists right now.

FloorSource.description: Which source set the floor (O-22, O-150).

FlopCoverage.description: One flop with its scenario count.

flop.description: The canonical flop text, for example `Ah7d2c`.

scenarios.description: How many scenarios the library holds on the flop.

status.description: The scenario status as the database records it.

texture_family.description: The texture family of the flop.

action_index.description: The index of the action taken, in the node's record order.

hand.description: The hand graded: a class (`AKs`) or a combo (`AhKh`).

node_key.description: The node key in the A3 section 1 grammar.

reference.description:
An opaque string of at most 64 characters, echoed back so the api service can
correlate attempts (O-156).

best_action_index.description: The first action with zero loss: the highest EV, the first on ties (O-130).

bucket.description: The chosen action's bucket as `gto_model::Bucket::as_str`; null when it has none.

ev_best_bb.description: The EV of the best action in bb.

ev_by_action.description: The EV of each action in big blinds (bb), in record order.

ev_chosen_bb.description: The EV of the chosen action in bb.

floor_pct_pot.description: The floor in percent of the pot the policy subtracts (O-22).

freq_by_action.description: The frequency of each action, in record order.

loss_bb.description: The loss of the chosen action in bb, raw and never clamped.

loss_pct_pot.description: The loss of the chosen action in percent of the pot, raw and never clamped.

loss_pct_pot_by_action.description:
The loss of every action in percent of the pot, in record order, raw and never
clamped; 0 for the best. Grouped and Simple modes grade a group by its smallest
member loss, so they need every action's loss from Rust (O-210, ADR 0004); additive.

node_key.description: The node key in its canonical text.

HandPosition.description: The queried hand's place in the acting seat's range.

equity_vs_villain.description: The hand's equity against the villain's reach-weighted range, 0 to 1.

rank_in_range.description: The hand's reach-weighted percentile by equity in the range, 0 to 1, 1 strongest.

relative.description: The hand against each aggressive action's threshold, in `actions` order.

HandRole.description: The role the hand plays at the node (O-153, plan C.3).

HandRow.description: One hand's row of the node.

ev_bb.description: The EV of each action in big blinds (bb), in record order.

ev_best_bb.description: The best action's EV in bb.

hand.description: The hand, a class name or a combo depending on the node's hand space.

loss_pct_pot.description: The loss of each action in percent of the pot, in record order; 0 for the best.

reach.description: Reach per seat in pair order (out of position first); null when the record has none.

strategy.description: The frequency of each action in record order, summing to 1.

HandSpaceName.description: The hand space of a node: the 169 preflop classes or the 1,326 combos (A3 section 4).

library.description: The solutions registry and the reader's cache.

Hex64.description: A 64-bit value written as sixteen lowercase hexadecimal digits (O-151).

blockers.description: The hand's blockers, present at every node.

oneOf.description: Both ranges' equity histograms; null at a postflop node in v1.
The hand's role; null at a postflop node in v1.
The nut advantage; null at a postflop node in v1.
The range advantage; null at a postflop node in v1.
The threshold card; null at a postflop node in v1.

LibraryHealth.description: The registry scanned at startup and the reader's frame cache (A3 section 5).

cache_bytes.description: The cache budget, `QUERY_CACHE_BYTES` or the library default.

cache_used_bytes.description: The bytes of decoded frames the cache holds now.

indexed.description: How many solutions the startup scan indexed.

unavailable.description: How many solutions the reader has marked unavailable since startup.

accuracy_pct_pot.description: The solve's accuracy at this node in percent of the pot, when the record carries it.

action_family.description:
The preflop action family of the decision at this node, from
`gto_model::ActionFamily::classify` over the key's pair and preflop line, as
`ActionFamily::as_str` (`rfi`, `facing-open`, ...); null at a postflop node. The api
matches drill families against it and never classifies a line itself (ADR 0004,
PR #25 re-review); additive.

config_id.description: The configuration identifier of the key.

floor_pct_pot.description: The grading floor at this node in percent of the pot (O-22, O-150).

hand_space.description: The hand space of the rows.

hands.description: The hand rows the filter selected.

node_key.description: The node key as given, in its canonical text.

pair.description: The position pair of the key, out of position first.

pot_cbb.description: The total pot at the node in cbb, including any outstanding bet.

range_summary.description: Both ranges and the split over the actions.

spot_class_key.description: The spot-class key of a preflop node under a catalog configuration; null otherwise.

stacks_cbb.description: Remaining stacks in cbb in pair order.

synthetic.description:
True when the solution is synthetic test data, from its manifest flag, so the web
shows the synthetic banner (O-57, O-229); additive.

NoiseFlag.description:
A warning that a number is near the solver's noise, at the node or for one hand
(05 section 9, O-153).

NutAdvantage.description: Which range holds more hands at or above the nut threshold (O-153).

ip_share.description: The in-position range's reach-weighted share at or above the threshold.

oop_share.description: The out-of-position range's reach-weighted share at or above the threshold.

threshold_equity.description: The equity a hand needs to count as a nut hand, 0.80.

to_act_advantage.description: The acting seat's share minus the other seat's.

PreflopCoverage.description: Preflop availability for the configuration and pair.

available.description: True when at least one preflop solution is held.

solution_ids.description: The solution ids held, registry first.

sources.description: Where each id in `solution_ids` was found, in the same order.

synthetic.description:
True when a held preflop solution is synthetic test data, so the web shows the
synthetic banner (O-57, O-229); additive, from the manifest flag.

detail.description: What went wrong in this occurrence; never a path beyond the store prefix.
detail.example: invalid node key "cfg/BB-BTN": expected 3 path segments

instance.description:
The request id (the `x-request-id` header, echoed); null until the request-id
middleware attaches it.

status.description: The Hypertext Transfer Protocol (HTTP) status code of the response.

title.description: A short summary of the kind of problem, the same for every occurrence.

type.description: A stable identifier of the kind of problem, `urn:g-tee-oh:problem:<tag>`.

position.description: The job's place in the queue, 1 first.

status.description: The job status as the database records it.

ip_mean_equity.description: The in-position range's reach-weighted mean equity.

oop_mean_equity.description: The out-of-position range's reach-weighted mean equity.

to_act_advantage_pct_points.description: The acting seat's mean minus one half, in percentage points.

RangeSummary.description: Both ranges and how the acting seat's range splits over the actions.

by_action.description: One entry per action in record order.

Relative.description: Where the queried hand sits against one action's threshold.

RelativePosition.description: The queried hand against one threshold.

index.description: The action's index in the record.

position.description: Above, at or below the threshold.

board.description: The board revealed so far as text, for example `Ah7d2cKh`.

cards.description: The street's cards: three on the flop, one after.

Revealed.description: The streets revealed so far, as board text; every entry is null when the deal is made.

flop.description: The flop once revealed, for example `Ah7d2c`.

hand.description: The opponent's hand: a class (`AKs`) or a combo (`AhKh`).

node_key.description: The node key in the A3 section 1 grammar.

rng_state.description: The generator state to draw from.

action_index.description: The drawn action's index in the node's record order.

rng_state.description: The generator state after the draw, to send with the next request.

roll.description: The uniform draw in `[0, 1)` the action was picked with, for tests.

SeatRange.description: One seat's range at the node.

combos.description: How many combos the seat's range holds at the node.

SpotClassEntry.description: One spot class of a (configuration, pair), with its most frequent spots (O-270).

family.description: The action family, as `/v1/nodes` names it in `action_family`.

line_reach.description:
The probability that any decision of the class arises in the pair's tree: the sum
of the line reach of the class's first nodes along each line (a node under another
node of the same class is not counted again), in (0, 1].

solution_id.description: The solution the class was read from.

spot_class_key.description: The spot-class key, as `/v1/nodes` names it.

spots.description:
The class's spots, by line reach descending then line, at most
`MAX_SPOTS_PER_CLASS` (8).

TextureCoverage.description: One texture family with its counts.

flops.description: How many flops of the family are held.

scenarios.description: How many scenarios across those flops.

index.description: The action's index in the record.

share_taking.description: The reach-weighted share of the range taking the action.

weakest_hand_taking_half.description: The weakest hand playing the action at or above half its frequency; null when none.

ThresholdCard.description: The threshold card: which hands take each aggressive action and where the hand sits.

actions.description: One entry per aggressive action (bet, raise, all-in), in record order.

strongest_folding_hand.description: The strongest hand folding at or above half its frequency; null when none folds.
